fields.name: author
fields.comment: The subject of the caller who posted or began it.

fields.name: blocks
fields.comment: The structured parts a client renders beside the body, as posted or last edited; none once deleted.

fields.name: body
fields.comment: The text, Markdown: the draft so far while composing; empty once deleted.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.comment: When it was posted, or for a message begin started, when it began, in epoch milliseconds: its place in the conversation's order, which never changes.

fields.name: editedAt
fields.comment: When it was last edited, in epoch milliseconds; absent when it never was, or once deleted.

fields.name: edits
fields.comment: How many times it was edited; listEdits reads the text before each. 0 once deleted.

fields.name: for
fields.comment: The subject the message was written for: the person the agent or service that posted or began it acted for (D77); absent when it acted for nobody.

fields.name: id
fields.comment: The message's number on the instance: 1, 2, 3, ...; never reused.

fields.name: lastReplyAt
fields.comment: On a top-level message: the greatest postedAt of its thread's posted or interrupted replies; absent while it has none.

fields.name: mentions
fields.comment: The subjects the message names for someone to hear of it; none once deleted.

fields.name: participants
fields.comment: On a top-level message: the subjects that have a posted or interrupted message in its thread, the top-level one included, the one whose latest such message is latest first, at most 10.

fields.name: postedAt
fields.comment: When it came to stand, posted or interrupted, in epoch milliseconds: a post's time, which is its createdAt, or the time of the finish or the interrupt of a message begin started. Absent while composing, and on a message deleted while composing.

fields.name: quotes
fields.comment: The id of the message of the thread the reply quotes.

fields.name: reactions
fields.comment: The reactions, by emoji, in the order each emoji was first given: how many, and whether the caller is among them. None once deleted.

fields.name: replies
fields.comment: On a top-level message: how many posted or interrupted replies its thread has.

fields.name: resolved
fields.comment: On a top-level message whose thread is resolved: who resolved it, for whom when it acted for someone, and when.

fields.name: stand
fields.comment: The message's place in the order the conversation's messages came to stand: 1, 2, 3, ... on the instance, given when it is posted, finished or interrupted and never changed. A streamed reply that began early and finished late stands after the messages posted meanwhile, so a reader compares it, not the id, with its read marker. Absent while composing, and on a message deleted while composing.

fields.name: state
fields.comment: composing, posted, interrupted or deleted. A composing message holds its place while its author writes it; an interrupted one holds what its author wrote before it stopped appending; a deleted one keeps its place, its author and its replies, and holds no text.

fields.name: thread
fields.comment: For a reply, the id of the top-level message whose thread it is in; absent on a top-level message.

fields.name: via
fields.comment: The deployable of the service whose call posted or began it (D37).

fields.name: mine
fields.comment: Whether the caller reacted with the emoji.

fields.name: after
fields.comment: The page is the earliest messages with a higher id.

fields.name: around
fields.comment: A message of the listing: the page holds it and the messages either side of it. At most one of around, before and after.

fields.name: before
fields.comment: The page is the latest messages with a lower id.

fields.name: limit
fields.comment: At most this many messages; 50 when absent.

fields.name: thread
fields.comment: The id of a top-level message: the page is its thread's replies, and the result carries the message as root.

fields.name: after
fields.comment: The id to pass as after for the page of newer messages: the last item's, when the listing has a newer message; null when it has none or the page is empty.

fields.name: before
fields.comment: The id to pass as before for the page of older messages: the first item's, when the listing has an older message; null when it has none or the page is empty.

fields.name: readUpTo
fields.comment: The caller's read marker on the listing, the conversation's or with thread the thread's: a message of another whose stand is above it is unread. Absent while the caller has none.

fields.name: root
fields.comment: With thread, the thread's top-level message.

operationSets.name: TicketComments
operationSets.comment:
A ticket's conversation for any signed-in caller (D103's step 4): each
of Comments' operations a table runs is a route of its own
(ticket/{id}/comments/post, ticket/{id}/comments/list-messages, ...);
the ones it leaves out, and those of the namespace, are left out with a
warning each.

operations.name: commentsPost
operations.comment: Posts a message as the caller: top-level, or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread. A composing message has no thread to reply in and cannot be quoted. A ref block's instance must be one the caller may read, each block's kind one the config allows, and an attachment's uri scheme, media type and size ones the config's attachments allow. A caller acting for someone records that subject as the message's for. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and posts nothing.

docs.title: Ticket comments: post
docs.description: Posts a message as the caller: top-level, or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread. A composing message has no thread to reply in and cannot be quoted. A ref block's instance must be one the caller may read, each block's kind one the config allows, and an attachment's uri scheme, media type and size ones the config's attachments allow. A caller acting for someone records that subject as the message's for. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and posts nothing.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

operations.name: commentsEdit
operations.comment: Replaces a posted or interrupted message's body, blocks or mentions, keeping what it held before for listEdits; an edit by its author posts an interrupted message. Its author may, within the config's editWindowMs of its postedAt when it sets one; a caller holding moderatePermission may edit any message, at any time. A ref block not on the message before must name an instance the caller may read, and an attachment not on it before must be one the config's attachments allow; a code block equal to the one at its place before keeps its moves. Acting for the author is not being it: only the author's own subject, or moderatePermission, may edit.

docs.title: Ticket comments: edit
docs.description: Replaces a posted or interrupted message's body, blocks or mentions, keeping what it held before for listEdits; an edit by its author posts an interrupted message. Its author may, within the config's editWindowMs of its postedAt when it sets one; a caller holding moderatePermission may edit any message, at any time. A ref block not on the message before must name an instance the caller may read, and an attachment not on it before must be one the config's attachments allow; a code block equal to the one at its place before keeps its moves. Acting for the author is not being it: only the author's own subject, or moderatePermission, may edit.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

operations.name: commentsDeleteMessage
operations.comment: Deletes a message, a composing one included, which drops its draft: its author may, or a caller holding moderatePermission. The message keeps its id, its place, its author and its thread's replies, and loses its body, blocks, mentions, reactions, pin and the text its edits kept.

docs.title: Ticket comments: delete message
docs.description: Deletes a message, a composing one included, which drops its draft: its author may, or a caller holding moderatePermission. The message keeps its id, its place, its author and its thread's replies, and loses its body, blocks, mentions, reactions, pin and the text its edits kept.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

operations.name: commentsPurge
operations.comment: Removes a message, its edits and its reactions from the conversation, and for a top-level message its whole thread; needs moderatePermission. A purged message's id is not reused, and the copies earlier events hold stay until retention prunes them.

docs.title: Ticket comments: purge
docs.description: Removes a message, its edits and its reactions from the conversation, and for a top-level message its whole thread; needs moderatePermission. A purged message's id is not reused, and the copies earlier events hold stay until retention prunes them.

operations.name: commentsListMessages
operations.comment: Lists a page of the conversation's top-level messages, or with thread a page of that thread's replies, composing and deleted ones included, a composing one with its draft so far as its body, in ascending id order: the latest page when no anchor is given, the page before or after a message id, or the page around a message of the listing. Each page says where the next older and newer ones start.

Each page says where the next older and newer ones start.
